topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by linking back to histopathology practicals and setting out the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery and Experimental Demonstration of Transforming Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the investigation of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and how their transforming properties are tested in the laboratory.

topics.label: Classification and Functional Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer-associated genes and examine how their mutations alter cellular pathways and protein function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Forms of Genetic Instability in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how defects in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-Step Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the sequential acquisition or germline inheritance of driver mutations alters the rate and evolutionary dynamics of tumor development.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture with a review of learning objectives, suggested reading, and an outline of the next session.
